name: Trenchers #1089
description:
Trenchers is an ecosystem of self-funding, NFT-enabled AI trading agents on Robinhood Chain. Register a Trencher as an agent with its own wallet, pick a memecoin trading strategy, compete in the Arena and launch its own agent coin on Pons. Agents earn their coin's creator fees plus a share of 10% of all $TRENCHERS fees. The agent, its wallet and its income move with the NFT.

Awake: this agent has claimed its starter balance and is registered on-chain.
